title: Electric Field Effect in Atomically Thin Carbon Films
abstract: Experimental isolation, micromechanical cleavage, and electric field effect discovery of pristine monolayer graphene. Demonstrates ambipolar field-effect mobility up to ~10,000 cm²/(V·s) at room temperature.

roles.graphene: Experimental isolation and ground-state baseline (Delta E = 0.000 eV/atom)
roles.h6^1_191: Crystallographic wallpaper group p6mm / P6/mmm reference

title: Prediction of a class of planar sp2-bonded carbon allotropes
abstract: First theoretical prediction of pentaheptite 5-7 ring carbon networks. Proposes fully coordinated sp² planar sheets composed exclusively of alternating pentagons and heptagons, displaying intrinsic metallic band structures.

roles.pentaheptite: Original theoretical proposal of pentaheptite (Cmmm, 16 atoms)
roles.c5^2_7^2_65: Primary structural formulation of 5-7 covalent metal

title: New metallic allotropes of planar and tubular carbon
abstract: Prediction of Haeckelite planar and tubular carbon allotropes containing square, pentagonal, and heptagonal defects. Demonstrates robust intrinsic metallic conductivity and high in-plane stiffness.

title: Architecture of graphdiyne nanoscale films
abstract: Scalable bottom-up solution synthesis of graphdiyne nanoscale thin films via copper-catalyzed cross-coupling of hexaethynylbenzene. Confirms periodic sp-sp² hybridization.

roles.graphenylene: Comparative experimental benchmark for non-hexagonal conjugated films
roles.G-60: Cross-coupling precursor and diacetylene network reference

title: Graphene allotropes: Graphenylene, Net W, and Net C
abstract: Systematic electronic band structure calculations and structural stability analysis of graphenylene networks and related square-hexagonal-octagonal allotropes.

roles.graphenylene: Theoretical formulation of Net W and Net C topologies

title: Competition for Graphene: Novel Two-Dimensional sp2 Carbon Allotropes
abstract: Discovery of direction-dependent Dirac cones in 6,6,12-graphyne and β-graphyne. Demonstrates that relativistic linear dispersion can exist in planar sp² networks lacking hexagonal symmetry.

roles.biphenylene: Dirac cone symmetry analysis in rectangular lattices
roles.beta_gr: Electronic band structure benchmark and directional Fermi velocities

title: Bending Rigidity and Gaussian Bending Stiffness of Single-Layered Graphene
abstract: Comprehensive atomistic study of bending rigidity and Gaussian curvature stiffness in single-layer graphene, establishing the continuum elastic modulus threshold for 2D carbon sheets.

roles.graphene: Benchmark for in-plane and flexural 2D elastic moduli

title: Graphenylene, a unique two-dimensional carbon network with nondelocalized cyclohexatriene units
abstract: First-principles study of graphenylene (4-6-12 ring carbon network). Identifies nondelocalized cyclohexatriene units with alternating bond lengths (1.37 vs 1.48 Å), regular pore diameter (~3.2 Å), and narrow direct bandgap.

roles.graphenylene: Theoretical formulation of cyclohexatriene ring localization and pores
roles.h4^3_6^2_12^1_191: P6/mmm symmetry definition (12 atoms) and formation energy Delta E = +0.540 eV/atom

title: Pentahexoctite: A new two-dimensional allotrope of carbon
abstract: Proposes pentahexoctite, an sp² carbon monolayer comprising 5, 6, and 8 membered rings. Computes thermal stability using ab initio molecular dynamics at 1000 K and reveals metallic conductivity.

roles.alpha_gr: Pentahexoctite 5-6-8 structural optimization and phonon spectrum

title: Theoretical investigation on two-dimensional non-traditional carbon materials employing three-membered ring and four-membered ring as building blocks
abstract: Systematic first-principles analysis of carbon sheets containing cyclopropane (3-ring) and cyclobutadiene (4-ring) motifs. Identifies stability limits of high-angle strain geometries in C3-12 (h3^2_12^1_191).

roles.h3^2_12^1_191: Theoretical stability threshold of 3-12 network (C3-12) with P6/mmm symmetry
roles.G-51: Angular strain and cohesive energy benchmark

title: Phagraphene: A Low-Energy Graphene Allotrope Composed of 5-6-7 Carbon Rings with Distorted Dirac Cones
abstract: Ab initio evolutionary discovery of phagraphene containing 5-6-7 rings with directional Dirac cones. Exhibits thermodynamic formation energy of only +0.205 eV/atom above graphene, with distorted Dirac cones and Fermi velocity v_F ~ 6.3e5 m/s.

roles.phagraphene: Discovery of 5-6-7 low-energy allotrope and distorted Dirac cones

title: New carbon allotropes with metallic conducting properties: a first-principles prediction
abstract: Proposes α-, β-, and δ-phographene planar allotropes. Evaluates cohesive energies, mechanical tensile limits, and density of states across non-hexagonal polygon variations.

roles.alpha_gr: Electronic density of states and tensile failure strain

title: Popgraphene: a new 2D planar carbon allotrope composed of 5-8-5 carbon rings for high-performance lithium-ion battery anodes
abstract: Prediction of Popgraphene composed of 5-8-5 carbon rings (Cmmm symmetry, 12 atoms). Demonstrates ultrahigh theoretical Li capacity (1117 mAh/g) and low diffusion barriers (0.16 eV).

roles.c5^2_8^1_65: Original proposal of Popgraphene 5-8-5 polygon network
roles.G-42: Lithium adsorption kinetics and formation enthalpy

title: Microporosity as a new property control factor in graphene-like 2D allotropes
abstract: Identifies microporosity as a structural descriptor governing the electronic and adsorption behavior of non-hexagonal 2D carbon allotropes, focusing on Cmmm 28-atom sheets.

roles.c5^2_6^4_8^1_65: Microporosity index and planar area per atom definition

title: Synthesis and properties of free-standing monolayer amorphous carbon
abstract: Direct growth and atomic-resolution transmission electron microscopy of free-standing monolayer amorphous carbon (MAC). Proves Zachariasen glass model with continuous random distribution of 4-, 5-, 6-, 7-, 8-membered rings.

roles.biphenylene: Experimental observation of 4- and 8-membered ring clusters

title: Biphenylene network: A nonbenzenoid carbon allotrope
abstract: Bottom-up on-surface synthesis and bond-resolved scanning probe characterization of the periodic biphenylene network (4-6-8 rings). Confirms nonbenzenoid planar conjugation, metallic character, and formation energy Delta E = +0.456 eV/atom.

roles.biphenylene: Primary experimental realization, nc-AFM imaging, and STM spectroscopy
roles.r4^1_6^1_8^1_47: Girão taxonomy code verification on Au(111)
roles.G-02: Synthesis precursor debromination pathway on Au(111)

title: A first principles investigation on the structural, mechanical, electronic, and catalytic properties of biphenylene
abstract: DFT examination of the biphenylene network: computes in-plane Young’s modulus (258 N/m), Poisson ratio (0.33), 4500 K thermal melting persistence, and hydrogen evolution reaction (HER) catalytic Gibbs free energy (ΔG_H* ~ 0.08 eV).

roles.biphenylene: Mechanical stiffness tensor and HER Sabatier activity calculation
roles.G-02: Active site registry across 4-6 and 6-8 ring-neck boundaries

title: Scalable Synthesis and Characterization of Multilayer γ-Graphyne, New Carbon Crystals with a Small Direct Band Gap
venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society
abstract: Scalable chemical synthesis of crystalline multilayer γ-graphyne via dynamic covalent cross-coupling of terminal alkynes. Confirms direct optical band gap of ~0.48 eV and lattice constant a = 6.86 Å.

roles.G-60: Experimental benchmark for alkyne-linked porous carbon

title: Synthesis of a monolayer fullerene network
abstract: Interfacial synthesis of quasi-hexagonal (qHP) and quasi-tetragonal (qTP) polymeric monolayer fullerene C60 networks with regular intermolecular covalent bonds and band gap Eg ~ 1.6 eV.

title: Effective regulation of the electronic properties of a biphenylene network by hydrogenation and halogenation
abstract: First-principles study demonstrating that surface hydrogenation and halogenation open a tuneable direct bandgap up to 2.14 eV in the otherwise metallic biphenylene monolayer.

title: Classification of sp2-bonded carbon allotropes in two dimensions
abstract: Foundational classification establishing a rigorous polygon inventory notation (Girão ring symbols) and DFT-D3 relative formation energetics (ΔE) across 61 2D carbon allotropes. Standardizes 17 wallpaper group mappings and in-plane lattice constants.

roles.all: Foundational polygon taxonomy, standardized unit cells, and DFT-D3 relative energy baselines for all 61 catalog entries

title: Mendeley Data: 2D Carbon Allotropes Crystallographic Dataset (v2)
abstract: Open crystallographic repository containing authentic PBE-relaxed CIF files, optimized atomic fractional coordinates, and VASP DFT total energies for the 61 allotrope library.

roles.all: Authentic CIF files, fractional coordinates, and VASP POSCAR structures

title: NanoTube Construct: A web tool for digital construction of nanotubes and junction models
abstract: Interactive web software tool for geometric roll-up of 2D graphene and planar allotropes into arbitrary chiral nanotubes, topological junctions, and capped structures.

title: PHOTH-graphene: a new 2D carbon allotrope with low barriers for Li-ion mobility
abstract: Theoretical discovery of PHOTH-graphene, an sp² planar network comprising 4-, 5-, 6-, 7-, and 8-membered rings (Pmm2 symmetry, 18 atoms). Confirms dynamic stability via phonon dispersion and reports ultra-low Li-ion diffusion barrier of 0.14 eV.

roles.photh_graphene: Seminal discovery of 4-5-6-7-8 ring topology with Pmm2 (#25) symmetry
roles.G-09: Li-ion mobility and anode potential benchmark

title: A high-throughput framework and database for twisted 2D van der Waals bilayers
abstract: High-throughput computational framework and database for twisted 2D van der Waals bilayers, moiré superlattices, and inter-layer binding energetics across 2D materials.

title: Graph embedding tensor: unifying topological description, symmetry detection, and structure generation for two-dimensional carbon allotropes
abstract: Coordinate-free rank-3 embedding tensor Phi_{v,e,f} encoding wallpaper group symmetries and ring adjacency for 2D carbon. Eliminates geometric tolerance ambiguity and enables generative Stone-Wales crystal discovery.

roles.all: Coordinate-free rank-3 tensor encoding, tolerance-free flag graph symmetry detection, and generative crystal engine

title: A concise review of recently synthesized 2D carbon allotropes: Amorphous carbon, graphynes, biphenylene and fullerene networks
abstract: Comprehensive synthesis review synthesizing experimental progress on 2D non-hexagonal carbon allotropes (monolayer amorphous carbon, graphynes, biphenylene networks, and 2D C60 fullerene polymers).

roles.graphene: Pristine vs nonbenzenoid experimental synthesis comparison

abstract: Coordinate-free embedding tensor archive

title: C568: A new two-dimensional sp2-sp3 hybridized allotrope of carbon
abstract: First-principles design and stability analysis of C568, a two-dimensional sp2-sp3 hybridized carbon allotrope composed of 5-6-8 carbon rings. Demonstrates an indirect HSE06 band gap of 1.13 eV, thermal stability up to 800 K in AIMD simulations, and high in-plane carrier mobility of order 10^4 cm²/(V·s).

roles.c5^2_6^2_8^1_b_65: Theoretical prediction of C568: 5-6-8 carbon ring network with 1.13 eV indirect gap

title: Me-graphene: a graphene allotrope with near zero Poisson's ratio, sizeable band gap, and high carrier mobility
abstract: DFT prediction and electronic property characterization of Me-graphene, an allotrope of carbon featuring a near-zero Poisson's ratio (-0.007 to +0.021), a sizeable HSE06 band gap (~0.76 eV), and high directional electron mobilities up to 1.34 x 10^4 cm²/(V·s).

roles.graphene: Benchmark reference for auxetic response and near-zero in-plane Poisson ratio
roles.r5^2_6^1_8^1_47: Auxetic rectangular network prototype and high-mobility comparator
roles.c5^2_6^2_8^1_b_65: Theoretical characterization of Me-graphene (P-4m2-lb-C13): near-zero Poisson ratio and high mobility

title: Homo Citans and Carbon Allotropes: For an Ethics of Citation
abstract: Landmark study on citation ethics and high-rate duplicate rediscovery in carbon allotrope science. Establishes the SACADA database methodology and periodic graph isomorphism standards for crystallographic allotrope disambiguation.

roles.all: Foundational citation ethics and topological net isomorphism standard
